authority.purpose: Independently verify that repository status claims and the real customer lifecycle cannot silently produce incorrect data, unsafe deletion behavior, cross-tenant exposure or irreversible release failure.

evidence_layers: database migrations and current schema evidence
provider and platform official current documentation
included_customer_journey: provider connect and reporting account selection
provider Ads Manager versus Dataset V2 comparison
excluded: opening remediation packages before cross-package dependency analysis is complete
treating synthetic evidence as live acceptance
changing a status merely to make documents agree

non_negotiable_method.rule: A Done or PASS claim is verified only when all applicable axes agree. Missing evidence never becomes PASS.
non_negotiable_method.provider_semantics_rule: Current official provider/platform documentation must be checked for attribution, correction, absence, deletion, privacy, quota and review semantics. Assumptions are recorded as unknown.

risk_model.P0: Can show materially wrong customer data, lose or expose data, violate deletion/privacy/security obligations, corrupt tenant authority, or create a credible Shopify removal/review blocker.
risk_model.P1: Can create stale, incomplete, misleading or operationally unsafe behavior without immediate irreversible harm.
risk_model.P2: Governance, observability, maintainability or scale weakness that can later become a release blocker.
risk_model.P3: Cleanup or quality improvement with no current material customer or compliance impact.
risk_model.escalation_rule: A finding is scored by customer/platform impact, not implementation difficulty.

execution_waves.name: Inventory and status truth map
execution_waves.output: Complete E1-E14 and R package inventory with every Done/PASS/Pending claim and evidence pointer.

execution_waves.name: Cross-package dependency and death-warrant review
execution_waves.output: Deduplicated P0/P1 register and dependency-ordered remediation package proposal.

stop_conditions: A production mutation is required to continue.
A destructive or irreversible check is proposed.
Provider credentials, tokens, PII or unredacted payloads could be exposed.
A missing business decision would materially change the audit conclusion.
Evidence conflicts and cannot be resolved read-only.
acceptance: Every E1-E14 epic and every R0-R11 package, including discovered subpackages, appears exactly once in the inventory.
Every Done/PASS claim is classified against the five evidence axes.
Every P0/P1 finding includes reproducible evidence and a safe acceptance requirement.
Known E9-T8 findings are preserved and reconciled into the final finding register without being prematurely closed.
Delete My Data, uninstall and clean reinstall are assessed as a separate P0 compliance journey.
No remediation implementation is mixed into audit evidence collection.
The audit ends with a dependency-ordered package proposal, not an automatic implementation authorization.
completion_rule: The audit may be marked complete only after all waves and deliverables are reviewed; completion does not mean findings are resolved.
